comments.content: If `range` is already a power of 2 (e.g. `max - min == 8`), `mp_round_next_power_of_2(range)` returns `range` itself, so `mask = range - 1` covers exactly `[0, range)` and the rejection loop is fine. However, if `range` exceeds `INT32_MAX`/is very large such that `mp_round_next_power_of_2` returns 0 (overflow when range > 2^31), `mask` becomes `UINT32_MAX` — verify `mp_round_next_power_of_2` handles the full uint32 range without overflow. For the playlist use case (num_entries) this is safe, but the API contract accepts arbitrary uint32 max, so please confirm/document the upper bound.
